coverage.note: All 67 VBM and all 67 early-voting county originals have October 28 portal uploads and reconcile to the 8:07 AM official compilation. No prior county records substituted. Portal upload dates are separate from individual activity dates; unchanged file hashes are disclosed. Sarasota retains 26 early records dated October 12. Live county totals may be newer and cannot be allocated to districts without newer district-coded files.

definitions.provided: VoteByMail status P (provided, not yet returned).
definitions.returnRate: Returned divided by sent/provided universe (V ÷ (P + V)).
definitions.early: Reported early in-person ballots from separate EVL county originals
definitions.cast: Unique recorded voters across returned VBM and early voting; same-person cross-method records counted once. Reported method counts remain unadjusted and reconcile to official sources.
